explore.description: Fast read-only codebase explorer. Delegate independent exploration in parallel: file searches, pattern hunts, architecture questions. Fan out 2-3 explore agents at once over disjoint areas (backend vs iOS vs specs/docs).

general.description: General-purpose worker for independent units of work. Delegate parallelizable backend, iOS, or specs/docs tasks via the Task tool. Default fan-out is 4 agents, hard ceiling 6, explore-only work stays at 3.
